name: personas-self
_comment: R2's first repo: Personas hires an App master over its OWN checkout. A second codebase is the only way to tell a driver that works from a driver that works on kp — the dossier, the declared gates and the objectives are all different here. rootPath must sit inside KP_APP_MASTER_REPO_ROOTS on the kp host.

dialog.context: The desktop app grew faster than anyone can hold in their head and the release checks are the only thing standing between us and a bad build. In three months a maintainer should be able to trust a green run without reading it.
dialog.title: App master for personas
